sql: SELECT geofips, geoname, "year", rpp_index FROM econ.regional_price_parities WHERE tablename='MARPP' AND line_code=3 AND (geoname ILIKE '%Austin%' OR geoname ILIKE '%San Antonio%' OR geoname ILIKE '%Dallas%' OR geoname ILIKE '%Houston%') AND "year" >= 2020 ORDER BY geoname, "year"
